title: WTF Is a Kilometer
blurb: 'WTF is a kilometer?!' — the battle cry of aggressive American unit ignorance, delivered with the confidence of a man who measures exclusively in bald eagles per football field. It became the anthem of ironic hyper-patriotism: play it whenever the metric system is mentioned, alongside the eagle screech for full effect. RAHHH. Freedom units only.
origin: A viral clip of performative American rejection of the metric system.
